تستشكلوا (form X)
# تَسْتَشْكِلُوا (tastaškilū) /tas.taʃ.ki.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# تُسْتَشْكَلُوا (tustaškalū) /tus.taʃ.ka.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
